content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Candidates having the required technical, engineering or professional qualifications as mentioned in the official notification can apply for the respective posts. Project Technician Posts: Candidates with relevant Diploma / Technical qualification in the concerned trade. Junior Project Engineer Posts: Candidates with relevant Engineering Degree in concerned discipline. Welfare Officer / Consultant: Candidates with required professional qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q1. What is the name of the organization conducting India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: India Optel Limited (IOL), a Defence Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India, is conducting this recruitment.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are released under India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 160 vacancies have been announced for Project Technician, Junior Project Engineer, Welfare Officer and Consultant posts.

faq.question: Q3. What are the posts available in India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts include Project Technician (Fitter Instruments), Project Technician (Fitter Electronics), Project Technician (Machinist), Project Technician (Optical Worker), Project Technician (Electroplater), Welfare Officer, Junior Project Engineer and Consultant.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is Offline. Candidates need to submit the application form as per the instructions given in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply for India Optel Limited Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The closing date for receipt of applications is 21 days from the publication of the advertisement in Employment News.
